gameDescriptionHtml:
Experience an unforgettable adventure of climbing to the top of a tower that holds secrets, using a ladder. Overcome challenges created by the environment and those created by yourself… and sometimes by the ladder.

Traverse and explore a wide range of environments, from a crystal cave, through a volcano and glacier, to a tower… but is it really the end? Find out!

The game on the default difficulty level contains 13 sub-levels. However, this may change depending on the difficulty level or accessing a side level.

Every failure is a step towards success, so the difficulty of the level depends entirely on the lessons you learn from your failures. Climb using the ladder, which is an essential part of your journey, but be careful! One wrong move or poorly placed ladder can result in resetting a significant part of your progress.!

Find crystals that offer minor support on your journey… but what if they have another purpose?

There are 2 crystals available in the default difficulty level. Each serves its own role, but their use may be somewhat limited.

Choose a ladder to your preference. Play to unlock more!

The game includes 4 base ladders and over 10 unlockable unique ladder skins.

Beat your own records or those of your friends! The leaderboard for each mode will update after every run, provided you complete it in a shorter time than before!

Doubting your abilities? Want to experience the creator’s original vision? Or have you completed the game and want to challenge yourself in a more demanding environment? Simply choose a difficulty level, and the game and world will adjust to your choice!

The game contains 3 difficulty levels:

Cat Mode – for those who prefer less demanding gameplay. The level length is shortened, customization is unavailable in this mode, the ladder is bigger, and there are many elements reminding you of taking the easy way out… shameful.

Normal Mode – The main vision of the creator and the intended experience of the game. Access to the full level, Easter eggs, and the selected ladder from the menu will be displayed during the game.

Hardcore Mode – A mode that can be unlocked after completing the game on normal difficulty. The level length remains unchanged, but the player’s path has been significantly modified to provide a greater challenge. This mode is unforgiving. One wrong move, and you start from the beginning.
